brief.title: One useful discovery
brief.objective: Create a 30-second live-action film about two makers in a workshop discovering how to repair a small handmade object. Begin with the place and their uncertainty, let one detail change their understanding, show their shared reaction, then end on a confident decision to work together. Use an entrance and a workbench as distinct setups where useful. Give concrete timed performance, useful phone framing and reachable camera/light movement. Do not invent spoken facts or force a fixed shot-size sequence.
